doubts: Start ref F2 is the only road end on Taylors Mistake Road, where the car park is said to be. Godley Head and Breeze Col car parks are on Summit Road but several Summit Road road ends exist (F1, F3-F7), so their refs are left null. Direction is not stated as clockwise/anticlockwise. Whether the loop passes through the Godley Head car park itself is implied ('From Godley Head car park, the track climbs') but the text also says the track between the gun emplacements and the car park has been rerouted.
